## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nicole Rivera_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "after this new update, I can't start my exercise from my Galaxy watch. the option to start any exercise from my watch is gone. this is ridiculous. I don't understand why such sweeping changes have to occur with every update. it wasn't broken, but now it is! I keep finding more and more reasons to go to Apple! Come on Samsung, stop messing with things!"
            2. _Diego Fasoli_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "The latest update has caused serious data synchronization issues. Despite having automatic backups turned on, my historical data is now heavily fragmented. Some long-term users have lost years of tracking. EDIT: after a second update to the their health ecosystem which didn't fix the problem, BMI measurement with my Samsung watch seems very buggy. I now need to measure it over a dozen times to make it work. I hope the next update won't mess up things even more. It's really sad and stressful."
            3. _J_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Update: New watch update is terrible. Stop changing things. Terrible interface after this new update. Samsung BLOATWARE. All my health records are gone. I use these records to show my doctors, and the records are now gone. These are my health records, and you removed them. It's unusable as is. I'll have to go back to using fitbit if it isn't changed back. Update: No, I will not call you at the number you left in the comment. I see that there are numerous 1 star reviews now after this update."
